forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,45 @@
+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M2X2EMGFB08X9F0XV40N54DH
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8280'
+title: 'Add a dotfolder document facade: read one path through the stack and split it'
+---
+## What
+
+A consumer must not read a dotfolder file by itself. Today `FoundationModelsSkills` opens `SKILL.md` with `FileManager`, then calls `FrontmatterDocument.split` by itself, then goes back to its own code. The layers are crossed two times, and each consumer must repeat the same steps.
+
+Add the second layer of the stack: a document facade over the combined view of card ^40n54dh.
+
+1. New type `DotfolderDocument`:
+   - `public var url: URL` — the file that won.
+   - `public var layer: DotfolderStack.Layer` — the layer that gave it. A consumer needs it for the trust of the render and for its own provenance.
+   - `public var frontmatterText: String?` — the raw text between the fences, or `nil`.
+   - `public var body: String` — the text after the closing fence, byte for byte. The full text when there is no frontmatter block.
+2. New functions on `DotfolderStack`:
+   - `public func document(at relativePath: String) -> DotfolderDocument?` — the winning copy of `relativePath`, read and split. `nil` when no layer holds it, or when the text is not UTF-8.
+   - `public func documents(in subdirectory: String? = nil, named fileName: String) -> [String: DotfolderDocument]` — for each child directory of the union that holds `fileName`, the document of that file. The key is the name of the child directory. This is what a skill catalog needs: one call gives each `<id>/SKILL.md`.
+3. `DotfolderDocument` holds no YAML. The decode of the frontmatter text is the work of the consumer, with its own codec.
+4. `FrontmatterDocument` stays public, but the documents state that `document(at:)` is the way that a consumer must use.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+
+- [ ] `document(at:)` gives the copy of the highest layer, with the layer that gave it.
+- [ ] `documents(in:named:)` gives one document for each child directory that holds the named file, and it skips a directory that does not hold it.
+- [ ] A file that is not valid UTF-8 gives `nil`, not an error.
+- [ ] A file with no frontmatter gives `frontmatterText == nil` and the full text as the body.
+- [ ] The body is equal to the text after the fence, byte for byte.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests` gives 0 warnings, and `swift test` is green.
+
+## Tests
+
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsExtrasTests/DotfolderDocumentTests.swift` (new): two layers hold the same path; `document(at:)` gives the higher copy and names its layer.
+- [ ] Same file: `documents(in: nil, named: "SKILL.md")` gives one entry for each child directory that holds the file, and no entry for a directory that does not.
+- [ ] Same file: a document with no frontmatter, a document with an unterminated fence, and a document with an empty frontmatter block each give the correct split.
+- [ ] Same file: a file that is not valid UTF-8 gives `nil`.
+- [ ] `swift test` — all tests pass, 0 failures.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
+
+#dotfolder-overlay #cross-repo
\ No newline at end of file
